<!-- pr-reviewer: 6dd3f77337a05ba96c6f77351947d38258beb584 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (together with #1005, which it contains; see "Merge order").

**What looks good**
- The refusal fails closed. `thread_entry::judge` (`crates/app/src/operation/thread_entry.rs:44-83`) is called from the Thread arm of `generate` (`generate.rs:2155`), so an Err means no toolpath and nothing to post. Every unknown is a refusal, never air: no prior grid (nothing ahead cut, program ahead cannot be cut - `drill_prior.rs:43-51` leaves `None` on a failed simulate - or a posed frame), a non-finite radius, and a hole off the grid ("cannot be judged"). Only a measured surface at or below the mill's lowest point passes.
- The read disk is the minor circle less one cell, never narrower than the mill, so a drill that opens only the mill's own width is refused (pinned at lib tests, 2.5 and 3.0 mm cuts).
- Reordering is covered: moving the Drill after the Thread marks the Thread Stale, shuts the post gate and regenerates to a refusal; undo restores Ok (`tests/thread_entry.rs`).
- No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests; provenance line present; module is 157 lines; decisions file present; no snapshot PNGs, process files, build.rs, scripts, .github or dependency changes; one golden moved and explained (Drill op added ahead, thread blocks identical).

**Local results** (worktree, trial-merged with upstream/main e6ee8f26 - merged cleanly, no conflicts; sccache build, own target/)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| app `--test thread_entry` | 5 passed |
| app `--test thread_mill` / `thread_mill_rim` | 8 / 11 passed |
| app `--test coarse_rims` / `hole_wall_flats` / `mill2d_b` / `mill2d_c` | 5 / 5 / 9 / 9 passed |
| app `--test golden_cl` / `solid_law_goldens` / `recorded_post_streams` | 30 / 7 / 5 passed |
| app `--test mcp` / `tool_gate` / `tool_law` / `drill_prior` | 20 / 9 / 4 / 12 passed |
| app `--test operations` | 119 passed, 6 ignored |
| app lib `thread` / motion lib `thread` / tools lib / sim lib | 7 / 8 / 77 / 135 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the UI suites and the rest of the quick-gate app suites (the author's gate at this head reports them green); `--ignored` release lanes.

**Merge order**
This branch contains #1005's head (f3dd45c4, ancestor check passes), so the two compose and the trial merge with main is clean. Order matters only for safety: merge #1005 first, then #1045 right after. Merging #1005 alone leaves main with a non-centre-cutting thread mill that can post into an undrilled hole until this lands; merging #1045 first would bring #1005's commits in with it, which also works but makes #1005 redundant. This PR does not build without #1005.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- A hole the thread path never enters is skipped (`lowest_in` returns None, pinned by `a_hole_the_path_never_enters_is_not_read`). Fine today because every thread move stays inside the minor circle; if a future thread form lets the mill leave it, that hole would go unjudged.
- As the body says, a cored FromModel stock with nothing ahead and posed (3+2) threads are refused rather than acquitted; both fail closed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
